content: Nungupala nmanye bhula pankakalika kutenda mahengo kwakya mwenga, kwakya bhandu bha Laodekia na kwakya bhandu bhoha bhaamokolite ng'obhe kumona kwa meho ghabhe.

Ningutenda habho ngati niyikamule mabhoko myoyo yabhe ma kuhutwa papamu mu upalo, ngati bhamememekehwe ungingilima ntangalo ghuugheghwa na umanyi ghwa hoto. Apo ndo ghwayimanya mbwepo ya Chapanga na ayo ndo ywombe Kilisto.
Nkati mwake ndo kuhihwa gha maha ghoha gha mahala na umanyi.
Hinu nungualongela nkotoke kukuluhwa na mundu ywohele kwa malagho gha uhwangi hata paghabhegha gha umaha bhuli, nkotoke kuayihwa.

Nungulongela habhu payibhele nenga megha ng'obhe kutali na mwenga kimmili, peni mahwacho ghangu ghabhegha papamu na mwenga kinhuki, nunguyelelwa kiyaha nungubhona pammegha papamu ngingilima mu ubhyubhalilo ghwenu mu Kilisto yesu.
Kutama uhyono mu Kilisto
Kiyaha mwenga munnyitika Kilisto kubhegha Bambo, basi ntame mu kulilunga na ywombe.
Nng'endelele kuhyubhalila lilagho lya hoto lya Kilisto na maabhegha ngingilima mu kulilunga na ywombe.

Nnolekehe maha, mundu kakotoke kuapotoha kwa mahundo gha ukubhuhi gha malango gha bhandu, ngati ghene utandilo ghwake ndo mahundo gha hitohe hya bhandu na gha mandilu atabhala, na chepa gha kuhuma kwa Kilisto mwene.
Mana, Nkati mwake Kilisto mu umundu ghwake, ghubhegha utwihiliko ghwoha ghwa Chapanga.
Na mwenga, kiyaha nnungana na Kilisto, mpeghwa ubhumi ngenju, na ywombe kabhegha unani muno mwa ghubhutwa ghwoha na kila tabhala.

Kiyaha mulilunga na Kilisto, mwenga nlumulwa unyagho, peni chepa kulumulwa unyagho kuutendekwa na bhandu, ngati kuutendekwa na Kilisto mwene, kwene kuutendekwa kukomboleghwa kubhuka mu umndu ghwa ulemwa
Kiyaha pambatisitwe mukikulilwa papamu na Kilisto, na muubatiso bhubho mwenga mukihyuhwa papamu na Kilisto kwa njila ya kuhyubhalila mu makakala gha Chapanga ghene kakinhyuha Kilisto kuhuma mu Kiho.

Apo makachu, kiuhuki mwenga mukihwegha kubhukana na ulemwa ghwenu, na kiyaha mwenga mukibhegha bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi. Peni Chapanga kabhapegha mwenga ubhumi papamu na Kilisto. Chapanga katulekekeha ulemwa ghwetu ghwoha,
kakitakulila kutali lihamba lya lighambo liibhoneha kukita tungughambwa na mihilo yake, na kuikachula kyanalumu kwa kuibhangalilila ku lupingika.
Pala palupingika, Kilisto kakiapoka makakala ghabhe Mandilu na utabhala bha nnima, kakiapegha honi pakindandabhanji pa bhandu na kuakulubhuha kwa ukangamalo handa apukilwa kubhoneha kakiahotola.
Basi, nkotoke kuyitikila kupeghwa mihilo na mundu ywohele, kwakya hilyo ebu kinywegho, manjubha gha chekwa ebu kikubhukubhu kya nlandamo ghwa mwehi ebu Linjubha lya Kupumulila.
Milando ya luhumu alu ndo kihighi ghweka kwa yila milando yiipala kuhika, uhoto ghwene ndo Kilisto mwene.

Nkotoke kunyitikila mundu ywohele yunakuliloka kukita ndo ywa maha na utokomaho na kutundamila mahoka, mundu handa ayu kakotoke kuapoka lilumbo lyenu lya manjubha ghoha ghanga uhiko. Aywo ndo nhila mahala kwa mahwacho mahakataho gha pannima,

kangi aywo kalibhika kutali na Kilisto handa mutwe ghungulibhuha kwa Kilisto wmwene kangulongoha bhandu bhake handa mutwe ghungulongoha mmili, kuhuma kwa mmili ghwoha ghumokola kulyegha na kukua. Kangi kangulunganiha mmili ghwoha papamu na misipa, habho ndo pakapala Chapanga.
Kuhwegha na kutama papamu na Kilisto
Mwenga nhwegha papamu na Kilisto na nkombolelwa kuhuma mumakakala gha Mandilo bhaatabhala nnima, kiyaha niki mungutama handa bhandu munnima? Bhuli mungughayitikila malaghilo gha munnima aghu?
Handa bhula, “Nkotoke kukikamula aki, nkotoke kukipaha kila, nkotoke kubyala kila”
Malaghilo handa agho ndo mahundo gha bhandu ghweka kulinga milando yiipyokoka mbole yakutumila.

Ndo hoto Bhandu abho bhangutughila mihilo handa ayi yiibhonekana kubhegha na malango gha njila ya kupalaha kuntundamila Chapanga yaayibhikilite bhene, bhanguhihyatula mibhili yabhe na kuatenda ahwamwe, peni yingunoghwa ng'obhe kukanikiha tama hya mmili.
